subject: Next steps: urgent capacity & deployment path for FastRetail incident
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Sanchez <marta.sanchez@fastretail.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-10T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery recap + immediate options to address this morning's latency incident

Hi Marta / FastRetail team,

Thanks for taking the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can move fast: 

Summary of the problem
- You saw sustained 5–7x increase in token throughput on the recommendation API starting 2026-05-09 22:00 UTC, which pushed you past the soft rate limits on Hosted and caused elevated 95th percentile latencies (1.2s -> 3.8s).
- Primary constraint appears to be concurrent request capacity and per-customer burst limits on the Hosted tier; we also saw repeated 503s during peak windows.

Customer constraints you flagged
- PCI-sensitive flows for checkout (card tokenization) must be isolated — you noted that a Private/VPC/on-prem route is preferred for payment-sensitive endpoints, but that procurement timelines are tight.
- Short-term priority: restore consistent latency and eliminate 503s during peak traffic (Black Friday ramp-style volumes).

Immediate options (tradeoffs):
1) Temporary Dedicated reservation (recommended immediate action): 2-week burst reservation sized to current peak (~8 x current Hosted capacity) to eliminate throttles. Fastest to provision (24–48h), keeps traffic in Redwood-managed infra.
2) Hosted scaling + emergency quota increase: quickest for small bursts but limited by Hosted soft limits and multi-tenant controls; still may hit isolation/PCI concerns.
3) Private VPC pilot (longer runway): satisfies PCI/isolation requirements but takes procurement + network setup (2–6 weeks depending on firewall/KMS work).

Attachments I shared: capacity worksheet and the incident log we received earlier: [Attachment: redwood_capacity_bump.xlsx (spreadsheet)], [Attachment: fastretail_incident_log_20260509.txt (text)]

Proposed next steps
- Fast action: approve a 2-week Dedicated reservation (we can size based on the attached worksheet). Redwood will ingrain a burst route and autoscale rules to avoid throttles.
- Parallel track: open Private evaluation with Security/Procurement. I can loop in our Private deployment team and get an SOW draft started if you want.

Can you confirm by EOD whether we should start the Dedicated provisioning? If so, I'll trigger the ops runbook and get Lauren to own the capacity sizing & activation timeline.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

---
Note: If you prefer a brief morning sync tomorrow to walk the runbook, I can book 30 minutes.

From: Marta Sanchez <marta.sanchez@fastretail.co>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@fastretail.co; procurement@fastretail.co
Date: 2026-05-11T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + immediate options to address this morning's latency incident

Karthik,

Appreciate the clear options. We need Reliability above all right now — the checkout retries are already causing lost revenue. Procurement and Security are on the thread to speed things up. 

Short answers:
- Yes to the Dedicated 2-week bump as an emergency mitigation. We need start-to-finish timing and an ops runbook for the activation.
- Security reminder: any solution that keeps card/token work on multi-tenant Hosted is non-starter for PROD checkout. For non-checkout endpoints we can temporarily tolerate Hosted while we evaluate Private.
- Procurement: we need a draft SOW and an estimate (monthly) for Dedicated pricing to expedite PO approval.

Please send the runbook and the Dedicated sizing by EOD. We can schedule a procurement touchpoint tomorrow 11:00 PT.

Thanks,
Marta Sanchez
Head of Platform Operations, FastRetail Inc
marta.sanchez@fastretail.co

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-11T12:00:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Discovery recap + immediate options to address this morning's latency incident (technical note)

Karthik / Lauren — quick technical assessment and activation plan for the Dedicated bump.

Findings from the telemetry we pulled:
- Peak concurrency aligns with recommendation service invocations from 22:00-02:00 UTC. Median token length per request ~420 tokens. KV-cache hit low due to customer query patterns.
- Hosted tier is hitting per-customer soft concurrency limit (configured at region-level). 503s are from internal queue rejections under sustained burst.

Immediate plan (fastest path, low-risk):
A) Provision a Dedicated pool sized for ~2.5x current peak to start (temporary) and enable burst autoscaling up to 8x for 48h while we validate metrics. This gives us breathing room and avoids immediate code changes.
B) Apply prefix caching suggestions on the recommendations endpoint to improve KV hit-rate (we can ship small prompt-side changes in 1 sprint).
C) Parallel: start Private VPC intake — I'll collect security questions and a SOC2 evidence bundle; procurement can review the SOW attached.

Estimated activation timeline:
- Dedicated provisioning: 24–36 hours once we have formal approval and a signed change request (I/O to infra team today).
- Monitoring: we'll provide a dedicated dashboard and 15-min alerting during the 48h burst window.

Attachments for procurement/ops: [Attachment: redwood_capacity_bump.xlsx], [Attachment: SOW_FastRetail_Draft.pdf]

I'll stand by to join the procurement meeting at 11:00 PT. Lauren — want me to prep the capacity dashboard and runbook now?

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Date: 2026-05-12T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Final: emergency Dedicated approve + parallel Private intake (action items)

Marta / FastRetail team — thanks for the fast turnaround. Confirming the plan so we have an auditable trail and clear owners.

Decision (per your confirmation):
- Redwood to provision a Dedicated reservation for 2 weeks as an emergency mitigation, sized as Marissa recommended (initial 2.5x peak with 48h burst to 8x if needed).
- Parallel track to start Private (VPC) evaluation for checkout flows. Redwood to deliver SOC2 evidence pack and a Private SOW draft for procurement.

Action items & owners
- Karthik: create a concise change request doc and email to infra ops to start provisioning (I will send now).
- Marissa: activate the capacity dashboard + 15-min alerting; deliver the runbook and monitoring links (target: within 6 hours).
- Lauren: be point for procurement on SOW/pricing; provide monthly cost estimate and quick PO path (target: draft by EOD).
- FastRetail procurement: review SOW_Draft and return any redlines; security to confirm acceptance criteria for checkout migration.

Attachments included for procurement and ops: [Attachment: redwood_capacity_bump.xlsx], [Attachment: SOW_FastRetail_Draft.pdf], [Attachment: fastretail_incident_log_20260509.txt]

I'll follow up with infra ops and copy the runbook into the HubSpot deal record: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/FR-1843

If anyone prefers a short war-room, I'm available now and through the morning.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
